summary: The team held a short standup focused on progress across backend and UI tasks. Liam confirmed that the authentication module was fully completed and only required a final review before deployment. Mia added that the dashboard widget updates had been finished and pushed successfully. With no major blockers identified, Ava closed the meeting by assigning one clear action item: Liam would request the final backend review the same day. The meeting conveyed steady progress and confidence in the upcoming deployment steps.

The design team gathered to finalize the mobile layout. Ella presented an updated prototype featuring simplified navigation, which Noah agreed looked much cleaner. The only concern raised involved button spacing on smaller screens, which Leo suggested addressing by increasing padding by eight pixels. The group quickly aligned on the change and decided to lock the layout after applying the adjustment. The discussion was efficient and collaborative, resulting in a clear decision to finalize the updated design by the end of the day.

During the weekly performance review, Ethan reported a notable increase in user engagement following the recent release, with only a few minor UI issues being observed. Olivia asked about any outstanding concerns, and Sophia shared that testing for the new recommendations model had been completed smoothly. Given the positive results, the team agreed to deploy the model on Friday after final verification. The meeting wrapped up with optimism about the product's traction and a clear action plan for the upcoming deployment.
